NCT02444091: Cyclophosphamide in Myalgic Encephalopathy/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS)

limitations: Open-label; no placebo. Chemotherapy-grade risks (infection, infertility, secondary malignancy, cytopenias). Not for routine care. RituxME failure cautions against over-generalizing B-cell/immune hypotheses. Not medical advice. Tracker Preliminary label is not an OSMF A/B grade.
